_about: The exact reply the game prints for each moment in src/lib/if/scenes/moments.json, with line breaks folded to single spaces. Each is the TELL string in the Zork I source (1actions.zil, gverbs.zil); the two built from parts are noted.

strings.mailbox-opened: Opening the small mailbox reveals a leaflet.
strings.window-opened: With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
strings.leaves-grating-revealed: In disturbing the pile of leaves, a grating is revealed.
strings.grating-opened-below: The grating opens to reveal trees above you.
strings.rug-moved: With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room, revealing the dusty cover of a closed trap door.
strings.trap-door-opened: The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending into darkness.
strings.lamp-lit-cellar: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-troll-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-east-of-chasm: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-studio: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-grating-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-cyclops-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-round-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-egyptian-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-atlantis-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-loud-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-coal-mine: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.lamp-lit-machine-room: The brass lantern is now on.
strings.troll-killed: Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the carcass has disappeared.
strings.cyclops-flees: The cyclops, hearing the name of his father's deadly nemesis, flees the room by knocking down the wall on the east of the room.
strings.cyclops-asleep: A moment later, he lets out a yawn that nearly blows you over, and then falls fast asleep (what did you put in that drink, anyway?).
strings.dam-gates-open: The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
strings.dam-gates-closed: The sluice gates close and water starts to collect behind the dam.
strings.boat-inflated: The boat inflates and appears seaworthy.
strings.reservoir-south-drained: You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through the center of the room.
strings.reservoir-north-drained: You are in a large cavernous room, the south of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through there.
strings.reservoir-drained: You are on what used to be a large lake, but which is now a large mud pile. There are "shores" to the north and south.
strings.rainbow-solid-falls: Suddenly, the rainbow appears to become solid and, I venture, walkable (I think the giveaway was the stairs and bannister).
strings.rainbow-solid-end: Suddenly, the rainbow appears to become solid and, I venture, walkable (I think the giveaway was the stairs and bannister).
strings.hades-bell-hot: The bell suddenly becomes red hot and falls to the ground.
strings.hades-spirits-flee: Each word of the prayer reverberates through the hall in a deafening confusion. As the last word fades, a voice, loud and commanding, speaks: "Begone, fiends!" A heart-stopping scream fills the cavern, and the spirits, sensing a greater power, flee through the walls.
strings.dome-rope-tied: The rope drops over the side and comes within ten feet of the floor.
strings.torch-room-rope-below: A piece of rope descends from the railing above, ending some five feet above your head.
strings.mirror-broken: You have broken the mirror. I hope you have a seven years' supply of good luck handy.
strings.maintenance-leak: There is a rumbling sound and a stream of water appears to burst from the east wall of the room (apparently, a leak has occurred in a pipe).
strings.thief-dies: As the thief dies, the power of his magic decreases, and his treasures reappear:
strings.sandy-cave-scarab: You can see a scarab here in the sand.
strings.machine-runs: The machine comes to life (figuratively) with a dazzling display of colored lights and bizarre noises.
